description: Finds cities, sea and inland ports, rail and road terminals, inland depots, border crossings and airports by name, UN/LOCODE or IATA code, with coordinates, from an embedded list (GeoNames, UN/LOCODE, OurAirports). Use it to fill a leg's from and to.

kinds.description: Only places of these kinds: port (sea or inland port), rail and road (terminals), airport, inland (inland clearance depot), border (crossing), city. E.g. ["port"] for a sea or river leg, ["airport"] for an air leg

query.description: Place name, UN/LOCODE (NLRTM) or IATA code (CPH)

name: find_places
title: Find places
